description: Main server implementation for Focalboard, including server startup, shutdown, configuration, and process monitoring logic.

methods.name: isProcessRunning
methods.description: Checks if a process with given PID is running by sending signal 0.

methods.name: monitorPid
methods.description: Monitors a process by PID and exits if the process terminates.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point for server startup, configuration, and signal handling.

methods.name: startServer
methods.description: Initializes and starts the server with given parameters.

methods.name: stopServer
methods.description: Stops the running server if active.

methods.name: defaultLoggingConfig
methods.description: Provides default logging configuration in JSON format.
